item.description: Four-time F1 world champion Max Verstappen passes 100 amateur drivers in just 14 laps in an exhibition go-kart race at Silverstone. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Hants thrash Surrey to reach Women's One-Day Cup final
item.description: Maia Bouchier continues her superb form with the bat as her unbeaten 117 helps Hampshire beat Surrey to reach the One-Day Cup final. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.description: Hibernian sack head coach David Gray six games into the Scottish Premiership season, ending the former captain's 12-year stay at Easter Road. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Apuestas deportivas, publicidad y sexismo: el debate que abre Sydney Sweeney
item.description: ¿Qué imagen de las mujeres transmite una publicidad de apuestas deportivas protagonizada por Sydney Sweeney? Esta semana, en Ellas Hoy, analizamos la forma y el contenido de una campaña que ha reabierto el debate sobre la sexualización y la representación de las mujeres en el deporte de alto rendimiento. También revisamos las denuncias de abuso contra el tenista Alexander Zverev, tras su triunfo en el US Open, y abordamos las detenciones masivas de activistas que defienden los derechos LGTBIQ+ en Turquía. Fuente: France 24 - Español.

item.title: Lionel Messi set for emotional farewell as Argentina faces Benin
item.description: Lionel Messi’s international story may not be over just yet. After announcing his retirement from Argentina duty on August 29th, following the World Cup final defeat to Spain and the recent death of his father, Messi is set for one final farewell. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: Ivorian footballer Malick Yalcouyé falsely accused of lying about his age
item.description: During a Premier League match between Chelsea and Brighton, social media users started spreading rumours that 20-year-old Ivorian footballer Malick Yalcouyé is older than he claims to be. The rumours gained such proportion that the youth club where he trained decided to post photos of Yalcouyé throughout the years. Recently, similar accusations were made against the new Real Madrid striker Yan Diomandé. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: The FRANCE 24 Observers

item.title: What next for Gabriel and Man Utd?
item.description: On the night JJ Gabriel was supposed to become Manchester United's youngest player in history, the scramble is on to persuade him not to quit. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Kenya: First World Athletics Championships to be held in Africa
item.description: For the first time, the World Athletics Championships will be held on the African continent, with Kenya set to host the event in 2029. World Athletics President Sebastian Coe described Kenya's bid as "convincing and moving". Our Nairobi correspondent Bastien Renouil has the details. Fuente: France 24 - English.
item.dc:creator: FRANCE24

item.title: Edouard Mendy set to retire from Senegal duty after 59 caps
item.description: After 59 appearances for Senegal, Edouard Mendy could be saying goodbye to international football. According to Senegalese outlet Taggat, the 34-year-old goalkeeper has reportedly told incoming head coach Patrick Vieira that he intends to retire from international duty. Fuente: Africanews.

item.title: Fitzpatrick not '100% comfortable' with tour finals in Dubai
item.description: Matt Fitzpatrick says he is not "100% comfortable" with the prospect of travelling to Dubai for the season-ending DP World Tour Championship in November when he is due to be defending champion. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: What's gone wrong for Chelsea talent Kendry Paez?
item.description: Kendry Paez was one of the world's best young talents when Chelsea signed him as a 16-year-old. Three years later, he's playing for the Under-21s. So what has gone wrong? Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Charlotte to host WTA Finals from 2027
item.description: The WTA Finals will take place in the American city of Charlotte from 2027 on a three-year deal. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Hong Kong targets film tourism boom and higher-level tennis tournaments
item.description: Hong Kong will introduce themed tourism routes showcasing the city’s most recognisable filming locations and explore upgrading Victoria Park’s Centre Court to host higher-level tennis tournaments, as authorities seek to significantly increase the sector’s economic contribution under the city’s first five-year development plan. The 2026-30 blueprint aims to raise the tourism industry’s value added from HK$86.2 billion (US$10.9 billion) in 2024 to HK$126 billion by 2030 – an increase of about 40... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Bevan to play at fly-half in Wales' WXV opener
item.description: Keira Bevan is to switch half-back roles after being selected to play at 10 for Wales' WXV opener against South Africa in Cardiff on Friday. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Winter Olympic venues confirmed with events in two countries
item.description: The sporting venues for the 2030 Winter Games are confirmed, with events to be held in Lyon and the French Alps - except speed skating, which will take place in the Netherlands. Fuente: BBC Sport.
